states.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to Social leads
states.noAccessBody: Your role does not include the permission this screen needs ({permission}). Ask a workspace admin to add it to your role.
states.lockedTitle: Social leads is not part of your plan
states.lockedBody: Your current plan does not include lead sources, so you cannot view or create them. Upgrade to bring ad and landing-page leads into your contacts.
states.manageNeeded: You can look but not change anything here: changing sources needs the permission {permission}.

errors.conflict: Someone else changed this source while you were editing it. Reload to see their version; your unsaved edits would be lost.
errors.noAccess: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.planLocked: Your plan does not include Social leads. Upgrade to use it.
errors.planLimit: Your plan's limit on lead sources is reached. Upgrade your plan or delete a source you no longer use.
errors.nameTaken: Another source already has this name. Choose a different one.
errors.mappingInvalid: The mapping points at contact properties that cannot be filled from a lead.
errors.defaultsInvalid: Something in the rules is not part of this workspace (a user, pipeline, stage or lifecycle stage).
errors.notRetryable: Only leads that need review or failed can be retried. This one is already done or being processed.
errors.payloadPurged: The stored lead was deleted after its retention period, so there is nothing to retry.
errors.sourcePaused: This source is paused. Resume it to send a test lead or retry a lead.
errors.notFound: We could not find it. It may have been deleted.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.rateLimitedWait: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.validation: Some of what you entered is not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.badResponse: The server answered in a way this page does not understand. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, contact support.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.request: The request was not accepted. Check what you entered and try again.

details.unknown_property: This contact property does not exist or is switched off.
details.not_mappable: This property is calculated or points at another record, so a lead cannot fill it.
details.unknown_pipeline: This pipeline is not in your workspace.
details.unknown_stage: This deal stage is not in your workspace.
details.stage_not_in_pipeline: This stage belongs to a different pipeline.
details.pipeline_required: Choose the pipeline this stage belongs to.
details.unknown_or_lost_stage: This lifecycle stage does not exist or is a lost stage.
details.unknown_or_inactive_user: One of the selected people is not an active member of this workspace.

problems.secretLength: A shared secret is {min} to {max} characters.
problems.pathLength: A path is at most {max} characters.
problems.pathCharacters: A path cannot contain control characters.
problems.retentionRange: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {max}.
problems.countryCode: Enter a dial code of 1 to 4 digits, such as 91 or 44.
problems.ownerRoundRobin: Choose at least two people to take turns.
problems.dealTitleLength: The deal title is at most {max} characters.
problems.propertyRequired: Choose the contact property to fill.
problems.propertyKey: A property key starts with a letter and uses lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
problems.pathRequired: Say where in the payload the value is.

reasons.identity_conflict: Email or phone belongs to another contact

guidance.noContactPoint: The lead had neither a usable email nor a phone number. Fix the mapping or the default country code, then retry.
guidance.invalidPhone: A phone number was sent but could not be read as one, and there was no email. Check the phone mapping and the default country code, then retry.
guidance.planLimit: Your plan's contact limit is reached, so this lead could not become a contact. Upgrade your plan, then retry.
guidance.sourcePaused: The source was paused. Resume it, then retry.
guidance.internalError: Something went wrong while processing this lead. Retry it; if it fails again, share the reference from the error with support.
guidance.identityConflict: The lead joined an existing contact, but its email or phone already belongs to another contact, so that detail was not moved.
guidance.generic: This lead needs a look. Check the reason and the error, fix the mapping or the defaults if needed, then retry.

page.title: Social leads
page.description: Bring leads from your ads and landing pages into your contacts, with the owner, tag and deal you choose.

tabs.attention: {count, plural, one {# lead needs attention} other {# leads need attention}}

ads.intro: Choose where your leads come from. Every source ends in the same place: a contact with its source recorded, an owner, an optional deal and a notification.
ads.untilThen: Until then, send these leads through the Webhook with Zapier or Make.
ads.sourceCount: {count, plural, =0 {No sources yet} one {# source} other {# sources}}

webhook.name: Webhook
webhook.body: Post leads from any tool that can send a web request: Zapier, Make, a landing-page builder or your own form. It also carries LinkedIn, TikTok and Google Ads leads.

meta.name: Meta lead forms
meta.body: Facebook and Instagram lead ads, straight from your Page.

sources.empty: Create a webhook source to get a URL you can paste into Zapier, Make or your form tool. Leads sent to it become contacts.
sources.emptyNoManage: No lead source has been created yet. Ask someone who can manage lead sources to create one.
sources.caption: Lead sources

wizard.title: New lead source
wizard.description: Set up a webhook that turns incoming leads into contacts.
wizard.stepsLabel: Steps to create a lead source

stepHelp.basics: Say what this source is called and how long the raw lead data is kept.
stepHelp.rules: Choose the owner, tag, deal and notification for every lead that arrives.
stepHelp.connect: Your source exists. Copy the URL and token now: they are shown only once.
stepHelp.mapping: Tell us where each value sits in the data your tool sends. The preview shows the result as you type.

wizard.planLimit: Your plan's limit on lead sources is reached, so no new source can be created.
wizard.planLocked: Your plan does not include Social leads.
wizard.revealGone: The URL and token are no longer shown. If you did not keep them, open the source and rotate the token to get a new URL.

form.name: Source name
form.nameHint: For example Zapier: Facebook lead ads. Names are unique.
form.platformHint: What your contacts show as their source, for example Facebook or IndiaMART. Up to {max} characters.

secret.label: Shared secret
secret.isSet: A shared secret is set. Senders must send it in the X-Webhook-Secret header.
secret.notSet: No shared secret. Anyone with the URL can send leads.
secret.willRemove: The shared secret will be removed when you save.
secret.willReplace: The shared secret will be replaced when you save.
secret.willSet: A shared secret will be set when you save.
secret.hint: Optional. {min} to {max} characters. It is never shown again after you save.

form.externalIdPathHint: Where the sender's own id for a lead sits in the data, such as lead.id. It stops the same lead being added twice. Optional.
form.retentionHint: After this the stored data is deleted; the contact stays. 1 to {max} days.
form.membersFailed: We could not load your team, so people cannot be chosen right now. Reload the page to try again.
form.countryCodeHint: Added to phone numbers sent without one, for example 91. Without it, a number must come with its own country code.
form.lifecycleStageHint: The stage a new contact from this source starts in.
form.tagHint: Put on every contact this source brings. Leave empty for no tag.
form.ownerModeHint: Only applies to a contact that has no owner yet.
form.unknownMember: A person who is no longer available
form.ownerRoundRobinHint: Pick at least two. Leads go to each in turn; people who are no longer active are skipped.
form.dealEnabled: Create a deal for each new contact
form.dealEnabledHint: Off until you turn it on. A contact that already has an open deal does not get another.
form.pipelinesFailed: We could not load your pipelines. Pipeline and stage cannot be chosen right now.
form.dealStageNeedsPipeline: Choose a pipeline first to pick a stage.
form.dealTitleHint: These are filled from the lead: {tokens}.
form.notifyOwnerHint: An in-app notification when a new lead comes in. Test leads never notify.
form.notifyUsersHint: For example your sales manager. Up to 20 people.

mapping.contactHelp: Type a key (phone_number) or a path (lead.contact.phone, answers[0].value). Leave a box empty to look under the common names.

defaults.name: Looks for full_name, name, contact_name
defaults.phone: Looks for phone, mobile, phone_number, whatsapp

mapping.customHelp: Fill your own contact properties from the data your tool sends.
mapping.propertiesFailed: We could not load your contact properties, so type the property key instead.
mapping.attributionHelp: Where the campaign details sit. Anything left empty is looked for under its own name.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.help: What the mapping above makes of a lead. Nothing is saved or created by the preview.

pasteProblems.empty: Paste the JSON your tool sends.
pasteProblems.invalidJson: That is not valid JSON. Check for a missing quote, comma or bracket.
pasteProblems.notObject: A lead must be a JSON object: a set of keys and values between curly brackets.

preview.useLast: Use the last lead we received
preview.auditNote: Reading a lead we stored is recorded in the audit log. A pasted sample is not.
preview.fixDraft: Fix the highlighted mapping fields to see a preview.
preview.choose: Paste a sample or use the last lead we received to see the result.
preview.none: No lead received yet: paste a sample.

reasons.no_payload: There is no lead to read yet.
reasons.no_contact_point: No email and no phone were found.
reasons.invalid_phone: A phone was found but cannot be read as a number, and there is no email.
reasons.phone_unreadable: The phone cannot be read as a number; the email will be used.
reasons.email_invalid: The email is not a valid address and is ignored.

preview.phoneUnreadable: Could not be read as a number
preview.pathsFocusFirst: Click a mapping box first, then click a field to fill it.
preview.pathsMore: {count, plural, one {# more field} other {# more fields}}

reveal.titleCreated: Copy your URL and token now
reveal.bodyCreated: This is the only time they are shown. We keep only a fingerprint, so we cannot show them again.
reveal.bodyRotated: The old URL stopped working at once. This new one is shown only this time.
reveal.noOrigin: Put your API address in front of this path to get the full URL.
reveal.secretHint: This source also needs a shared secret: the sender must send it in the {header} header.
reveal.sampleHelp: In Zapier or Make, use a Webhooks action that posts JSON to the URL. This command sends one sample lead.
reveal.copied: I have copied the URL and token somewhere safe
reveal.doneHint: Tick the box first. After this the token cannot be shown again.

test.title: Send a test lead
test.help: Sends a sample lead through the real pipeline, marked as a test. It creates a real contact you can delete, and nobody is notified.
test.paused: This source is paused. Resume it to send a test lead.

payloadProblems.empty: Paste the JSON to send, or use the sample lead.
payloadProblems.invalidJson: That is not valid JSON. Check for a missing quote, comma or bracket.
payloadProblems.notObject: A lead must be a JSON object: a set of keys and values between curly brackets.

test.needsManage: Sending a test lead needs the permission leads.sources.manage.

watch.waiting: Waiting for the first lead. Paste the URL into your tool and send one.
watch.error: We could not check for leads just now.

detail.needsAttention: {count, plural, one {# lead needs attention} other {# leads need attention}}
detail.conflict: Someone else changed this source. Reload to see their version; your unsaved edits will be lost.
detail.connector: Connected through the Marketplace. It has no URL or token of its own; leads arrive through the installed app.
detail.urlOnce: The full URL was shown once when the source was created. To get a new one, rotate the token.
detail.secretYes: A shared secret is set: senders must send it in the X-Webhook-Secret header.
detail.pausedNote: This source is paused: its URL answers 404, so senders see an error until you resume it.
detail.settingsHelp: Changes apply to leads that arrive after you save. Retrying an old lead uses the current settings.

pause.title: Pause this source?
pause.body: While it is paused, its URL answers 404 and leads sent to it are not received. Resume it any time.

rotate.title: Rotate the token?
rotate.body: The current URL stops working at once, so update your tool with the new one. The new URL is shown only once.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: Its URL stops working and the leads it stored are deleted with it. Contacts it already created stay. This cannot be undone.

events.title: Leads received
events.help: Every lead that reached this source and what became of it. Newest first.
events.attentionTitle: {count, plural, one {# lead needs attention} other {# leads need attention}}
events.empty: Send a test lead or paste the URL into your tool.
events.deliveredAgain: {count, plural, one {Delivered again once} other {Delivered again # times}}

event.title: Lead details
event.auditNote: Opening the payload is recorded in the audit log.
event.deliveredAgain: {count, plural, one {Delivered again once} other {Delivered again # times}}
event.purged: The raw payload was purged after {days} days. The lead and its contact stay.
